parish of ballymoney & derrykeighan causeway family of parishes18th october 2026 29th sunday of ordinary time praying with (andfor) the pope this week pope leo is much in our thoughts. the holy father has asked us to pray this october for those dealing with mental health problems, their families and those who care for them. in a video he made a few weeks ago the pope prayed that those who are affected by mental health issues will get the help and support they need, that their dignity will be upheld and that the church will be a place of welcome and hope for them. but as well as praying with pope leo for this intention, we should also pray for him at this time. during the last week he has undergone surgery for what has been announced as lung cancer. we ask the lord to watch over the holy father, to give him strength during his treatment and to help him make a full recovery. parish of ballymoney & derrykeighan diocese of down & connor causeway family of parishes contact details very rev . damian mccaughan ppvf 81 castle street ballymoney co. antrim bt53 6jt tel:
